adversary.target: sign of the pair's net character change, read from the glyph rendering
adversary.note: Rows with zero net change are masked out of the auxiliary loss.

provenance.purpose: Option A polarity-adversarial run: penalise reliance on the net-polarity statistic so any remaining performance must be content-based.
provenance.ablation_baseline: checkpoints/cls_secure_code_prose_native_pilot_qwen15b_lora_v1 (same data, same schedule, no adversarial term)
provenance.held_out: all v4 suite keys plus both full PrimeVul eval pools (2050 keys)
provenance.decisive_metric: accuracy conditional on the polarity rule being wrong; must rise well above the 0.1944 of the non-adversarial pilot
